articles.title: Fenway Insider Live: Sean McAdam on what comes next for Red Sox
articles.description: MassLive’s Fenway Insider Sean McAdam hosted a mailbag Thursday, Oct. 8 to highlight the latest news from the Boston Red Sox.

articles.title: Should the Red Sox move on from Jarren Duran, Triston Casas or other arb eligible players?
articles.description: In the latest episode of MassLive’s Extra Point, Matt Vautour and Chris Mason debate arbitration projections for Red Sox players this offseason. They also dive into the biggest area of concern for the Patriots against the Raiders this weekend.

articles.title: Overlooked Red Sox prospect (54 stolen bases) didn’t ‘let up on the gas’
articles.description: Red Sox outfield prospect Andrews Opata stole 54 bases this season, second in the Carolina League and just one behind the leader.

articles.title: Fenway Insider: Submit questions for MassLive’s Sean McAdam
articles.description: What questions do you have for Sean McAdam this week? Drop them in the comments or send an email to fenwayinsider@masslive.com

articles.title: Alex Cora turns down Phillies again, plans another year away from dugout
articles.description: Alex Cora’s sabbatical from the dugout is expected to span another year. He once again informed the Phillies he doesn't want to manage them.

articles.title: Are the Red Sox in a better place as an organization compared to last year?
articles.description: Sean McAdam and Chris Cotillo discuss their biggest takeaways from the Red Sox' end-of-season press conference.

articles.title: What role will Curtis Mead have on ‘27 Red Sox? Plus Jason Varitek, coaching updates
articles.description: Sam Kennedy, Craig Breslow and Chad Tracy provided updates on Curtis Mead's role for 2027, Jason Varitek's status in the organization, the coaching staff, Garrett Crochet's shoulder and more during Monday's end-of-season press conference.

articles.title: Red Sox: Roman Anthony's recovery path is rest, not surgery
articles.description: Roman Anthony's hand injury does not require surgery, with Red Sox officials indicating that complete rest this offseason is the best path to recovery.

articles.title: Red Sox' Craig Breslow eyes offensive upgrades for 2nd straight winter
articles.description: For the second straight year, the Red Sox finished third in their division and were eliminated by the Yankees, with offensive inconsistency—particularly a lack of power—identified as the primary issue heading into the offseason.

articles.title: Red Sox president on ending of 2026: ‘Painful and deeply disappointing’
articles.description: Red Sox president Sam Kennedy: “The way it ended Wednesday night in New York was painful and deeply disappointing to all of us."

articles.title: Red Sox manager: Pitching calls in playoffs were 'my decision'
articles.description: Appearing at the first end-of-season press conference of his managerial tenure, Chad Tracy came ready to clear the air Monday when asked about some key in-game decisions that helped lead to the Red Sox’ quick postseason exit in the Bronx last week.

articles.title: Red Sox slugger met for ‘over 2 hours’ with Craig Breslow, Chad Tracy
articles.description: Red Sox slugger Willson Contreras spoke candidly about the reliance on analytics after the Yankees eliminated Boston in the AL Wild Card round on Wednesday.

articles.title: Aroldis Chapman passes physical, locks in return to Red Sox in 2027
articles.description: A long offseason for the Red Sox began with a contractual formality becoming official late last week as Aroldis Chapman passed an end-of-year physical to secure a return to the club.

articles.title: Some Things I Think I Think: Free agent market won’t have much to offer Red Sox
Red Sox' Gasper undergoes surgery after tearing biceps
articles.description: Two days after the Red Sox’ season ended in abrupt fashion in the Bronx, one of the late-season standouts who helped the club reach the postseason had surgery Friday.

articles.title: Analytics vs. players: Red Sox tensions boil over
articles.description: The Red Sox's wild card sweep exposed a deeper rift between players and management over analytics-driven in-game decisions, most notably the early removal of Sonny Gray in Game 2.
